summary.result: Since fly ash is known to improve many properties of concrete, while reducing strength properties, decision for using fly ash should be made carefully depending on the intended usage of the recycled concrete.
summary.background: The recycled concrete, average compressive strength of which was 2l0kg/cm $^2$ or higher with slump range of 14~18cm, was prepared by replacing 25% and 50% by weight of coarse aggregate with recycled aggregate from waste concrete.
summary.method: Mix design method for crushed aggregates was used and all specimens were cured by normal moisture curing method.
